body.statement: For all \(K,O\in\mathfrak G_p\) satisfying \(d_K=d_O\), if every \(\Gamma_i(K,O)\) and every \(\Gamma_i(O,K)\) has a perfect matching, then \(\operatorname{SCC}(K)=\operatorname{SCC}(O)\). Equivalently, if \(\operatorname{SCC}(K)\ne\operatorname{SCC}(O)\), then some graph order and vertex has \(\Delta_i>0\).
body.justification: H-star is the sole global combinatorial bottleneck and the proposal's theorem-level kernel.
body.gap: Theorem 4.13 of Drton, Hollering, and Wu proves the corresponding existence statement only when one graph is acyclic; no all-feedback proof or counterexample was found.
body.consumer: Together with Theorems 1 and 2, H-star makes every SCC-discordant equal-outdegree pair generically distinguishable by a computable precision coordinate set.
